notes.subject: car
notes.text: Coverage is only Generation 2: lower quality, circular blur above and below, and slightly off colours.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: White front and yellow rear plates like the United Kingdom, but with a red strip on the left.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Hilly farmland with narrow roads running through it.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Whitewashed houses and entrance walls are common, much like Ireland.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Striped kerbs sometimes line main roads.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Blue bollards are common in urban areas.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Bright yellow gorse flowers are very common; also found in rugged parts of the United Kingdom and Ireland.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The north is very flat compared with the rest of the island, usually with mountains visible to the south.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A twig-shaped smudge shows on the left of the lens in the south.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Rows of terraced houses and a higher density mark the capital.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Lamps with a blue base and small blue sticker are on most of the island; the first two letters show one of 21 parishes.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: All-green lamps are common in Ramsey and Castletown.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Many street signs in Ramsey show an oval coat of arms.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: A castle sitting on an island is visible at Peel.
